item.title: Version 3.13.0
item.description:
neoloopy 3.13.0 (build 67)

Quantitative modeling is free for everyone, Cloud is the one paid plan, organizations can license agent-based models, process authoring and document ingest, and any model moves between devices as a file. Everything in the [3.12.0 notes](3.12.0.md) still applies.

Scope

  • macOS, iOS and Android. The macOS app (DMG and Sparkle update) with the embedded neoloopy CLI and MCP server, the iOS app, and the Android app as a direct .apk. Windows and Linux builds stay at 3.5.0.
  • Processes (Petri nets) reach Android with this release; macOS and iOS already had them.

Free, Cloud and Commercial

  • Quantitative modeling is free. Stock-and-flow equations, simulation, scenarios, calibration, optimization, sensitivity and loop dominance no longer need a subscription, in the app and in the neoloopy CLI and MCP server. Viable System Model diagnosis, including its measured checks, is free as well.
  • Cloud is the one paid plan, $5 a month: end-to-end encrypted sync across your devices with 1 GiB of storage, up to 20 hosted publications, and private access to them. It replaces Sync and Pro. Existing Sync, Plus and Pro subscriptions and complimentary grants keep working, and a Pro subscription counts as a Commercial seat until it lapses.
  • Free accounts host 3 publications. Publishing a model or a simulation no longer needs a subscription. Archived publications count toward hosted storage until they are cleared, and publishing is limited to 100 times per 30 days.
  • Commercial license for organizations. Agent-based models, editing process models and document ingest need a Commercial license: licensed per seat with a minimum of 3 seats, pricing on request and arranged by contact. It includes Cloud. Everything you already built stays viewable and replayable. Individuals, education, research, non-profits and organizations under 250 employees and US$10M revenue use neoloopy under the free license; the full text is on the app's Legal screen, which also shows the organization a seat is licensed to.
  • On iPhone and iPad the app shows your plan but sells nothing. Add Cloud from neoloopy on the web or desktop, then sign in on the phone.

Move a model between devices

  • Export model… and Import. Any model exports to a single file from its menu and imports on another device, free and without an account. Importing a model that is already there asks whether to Replace it or Keep both. If an import fails, your previous version is kept under a name that says so. Agent-based model content is not included in model files. A model exported by a newer neoloopy asks you to update first.

In the app

  • The models list loads fast again. Since the 2026-10-31 source checks the roster re-read the vault once per model; it now reads it once. On a 54-model, 1500-note vault the list went from about a second to well under a tenth of one.
  • Run a process with the canvas in view on a phone. A run strip sits on the canvas and Insights docks below it with a grip, instead of covering the canvas. The Insights panel grows while the keyboard is up.
  • Canvas fixes. An unmoved tap on a target no longer deselects it on release, and a canvas disposes its controller with its route. A failure while watching a model file stays contained to that model.
  • Cloud storage full is reported in Sync with your usage; the 1 GiB limit is enforced by the server.

CLI and MCP server

  • Quantitative verbs run without a token. Agent-based, process-writing and document-ingest verbs need the Commercial scope and are hidden without it; the read verbs stay available. neoloopy --version reports 3.13.0.
